description: Official building names of the HKUST Clear Water Bay campus, transcribed by hand from the official HKUST Campus Map PDF (https://publish.ust.hk/univ/maps/Campus_Map_Color.pdf, accessed 2026-11-10). The map is a schematic without coordinates, so positions come from OpenStreetMap; 'aliases' are the names the same building carries in OpenStreetMap or Lands Department data and are used only for matching. Building abbreviations (CYT, LSK, IAS) are those used by HKUST's Path Advisor. 'zone' is this project's grouping. Transcription errors are possible.
